name: spinner
description: Animations while the model works: a mascot beside the spinner, a scene in a band above the prompt and a finale when the turn ends, in eight switchable themes

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The animations' look: cat, bunny, sakura, mecha, neon, dino, ocean, matrix, or random for a new one each session. /spinner <theme> switches it live

stage.title: Animation band
stage.description: A two-row animated scene above the prompt while the model works (/spinner stage off|on overrides it)

celebrate.title: Finale
celebrate.description: A short finale in the band when a turn ends: confetti and the time it took, or a sad face when interrupted

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of /spinner's replies and the finale's label; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
